violations.text: At the time of inspection, there was no person certified in food safety as required when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. PIC to additional employees are certified in food safety for times when the Certified Food Safety Manager is not on site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

Several food items in the pizza prep unit were observed at 43-48 degrees Fahrenheit (Unit was observed being used for cooling chicken breast at the time of inspection). Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Based on employee observation of pizza prep unit operating at 38 degrees Fahrenheit prior to inspection, food items were moved to colder refrigeration at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

Recently cooked chicken was observed cooling in a container greater than 4" deep in the Pizza Prep unit at 66 degrees Fahrenheit. Chicken was moved to a shallow pan and placed in the walk-in cooler for rapid cooling at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the Quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

Quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution was in excess of 400 parts per million (ppm). A quaternary ammonia sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be applied at the strength as indicated on the manufacturers' label (200 - 400 ppm). Sanitizer solution was adjusted to the proper range of 200 - 400 ppm at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2024

At the time of inspection, the small chest cooler gasket was observed to be in poor repair. A buildup of ice on the lid was not allowing for proper tight sealing of the lid. Equipment is to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the Walk-In Cooler fan shrouds were observed to have an accumulation of dust, dirt, and other debris. Non-FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. New Violation. Correct By: 09/07/2024

The sink used for food preparation is lacking a proper air gap (currently equipped with an air break. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. The prep sink drain is to be adjusted to a proper air break. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2024
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2024
The floor tile in the dishwashing area is in poor repair (chipped/cracking). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2024
